prompt: Build an offline event registration web app for college students using browser local storage. The app must allow free registrations, work offline, and not require any payments or accounts. Include registration validation and tests in the prototype. Specific features for the registration form, user interface design preferences, handling of local storage limits, and testing framework requirements remain to be specified. The development should follow the Rapid Prototyping methodology to quickly gather feedback and iterate on the app.
assumptions: The app will be developed for college students attending various events.
The app will utilize browser local storage for data persistence without exceeding storage limits.
